indicator_name: AI VC investment received, by location of AI firm
source_name: OECD (2026), Venture capital investments in artificial intelligence through 2025, OECD Policy Briefs No. 50 (data: Preqin via OECD.AI)
definition: Value of venture capital deals in AI firms located in the geography (destination of investment)
methodology_note: Manually transcribed from the brief's key findings and the section on VC flows (rounded as published). Data: OECD.AI, data from Preqin, last updated 2026-01-01. Single year: annual totals are volatile and dominated by mega-deals (73% of 2025 value). Price basis not stated in the brief. Text read from the Internet Archive copy of 2026-02-28. Published as about 75% of global AI VC (USD 258.7 billion).
